data.name: Siddesh
data.long_meaning: One who is the Lord of the Gods, the controller of all. Siddesh is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the word 'Sidh', which means accomplished, and 'Desh' which means land or realm. It is believed that this name represents the supreme being and the one who has achieved everything.

The name is popular among Hindus and is often given to baby boys as a sign of hope and aspiration for a perfect and accomplished life.
